messages.subject: A lot of NA
parts:
Hi, 

I'm currently working on a set of data with 76% of NA. I was wondering if anybody had work with that kind of data and if anybody knew a package that can be helpful for the analysis. 

Alice

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: A lot of NA
parts:
Hi Alice,

This is a challenging question to answer without more information.

Are most of these NAs on the precursor or fragment level, or are entire proteins missing? 

If the missingness is at the precursor or fragment-level you might be able to get away with simply using the imputation methods in MSstats (although I would check the imputed values to ensure they make sense).

If the missing values are at the protein-level, I personally do not believe there is a great way to recover them. You can make assumptions, such as the proteins are below the limit of detection, but you are moving away from quantitative analysis and toward qualitative analysis when you do this.

Devon
